remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 2 bed, 1 bath 2nd floor rental in the heart of SONO! This charming residence blends modern updates with original character, featuring updated fixtures, new appliances, nice sized kitchen with room for a table, a very large separate food pantry, a white, neutral and clean full bath with deep shower & tub combo, a sundrenched bedroom with large walk-in closet w/ laundry, and access to a 600 sqft of floored attic space for storage. Enjoy large parking area, and a lush backyard that backs up to Flax Hill Park. A detached rear deck provides the perfect space for entertaining, grilling, or unwinding outdoors. Conveniently located near SONO's Metro North station, restaurants, shops, and the Maritime Aquarium.
